tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search Gobkit's free CC0 low-poly 3D models (.glb). Rigged models carry named animation clips (idle, walk, attack, death …) — play them by name. Returns each model's direct .glb URL. Leave query empty to list everything of a kind.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model by name: its .glb URL, animation clip names, pack, licence and a three.js snippet that loads it and plays a clip by name.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Every free Gobkit pack: name, kind, how many models, the clip names, the zip with all of them and the cover picture.
